meaning.en: The newest stable release; a preview only when no stable release is listed
meaning.zh: 最新的稳定版；只有列表里没有稳定版时才是预览版

meaning.en: A release with -runtime installs .NET Runtime only; -aspnetcore installs ASP.NET Core Runtime
meaning.zh: 带 -runtime 的版本只安装 .NET Runtime；-aspnetcore 安装 ASP.NET Core Runtime

guide.en: Write a channel or a release: 8, 8.0 or 8.0.34, with -runtime or -aspnetcore for a smaller distribution. vfox search lists every installable variant, with its distribution and the version of its component in brackets. Use an exact version for a preview such as 11.0.0-rc.3: a channel picks its newest stable release, and a preview only when it has none. A version that matches no release for your platform fails the install with an error that names it, and installs nothing.
guide.zh: 写通道或发行版：8、8.0 或 8.0.34，加 -runtime 或 -aspnetcore 可安装较小的发行版。vfox search 列出每一个可安装的变体，并在方括号里写出发行版和组件版本。预览版如 11.0.0-rc.3 要用完整版本：通道选的是它最新的稳定版，只有通道里没有稳定版时才选预览版。找不到适用于本机平台的匹配版本时，安装会报错并指出该版本，且不安装任何东西。

tips.en: The plugin sets DOTNET_ROOT and puts the SDK directory on PATH; activate vfox in a script before running dotnet.
tips.zh: 插件会设置 DOTNET_ROOT 并把 SDK 目录加入 PATH；在脚本里运行 dotnet 之前要先激活 vfox。

tips.en: dotnet --version prints the SDK number, such as 8.0.428, which can be newer than the release vfox selected, such as 8.0.34.
tips.zh: dotnet --version 显示的是 SDK 号，如 8.0.428，可能比 vfox 选中的发行版（如 8.0.34）更新。

tips.en: Linux needs ICU, libssl and zlib.
tips.zh: Linux 上需要 ICU、libssl 和 zlib。

tips.en: Detect and link adopts .NET SDKs already on the machine: those under DOTNET_ROOT (or DOTNET_HOME when DOTNET_ROOT is not set), the Homebrew formulae, and the default directories of dotnet-install.sh and dotnet-install.ps1. It needs vfox 1.1.0 or later.
tips.zh: 探测并链接可纳入机器上已有的 .NET SDK：DOTNET_ROOT 指向的（未设置时为 DOTNET_HOME）、Homebrew 的公式，以及 dotnet-install.sh 与 dotnet-install.ps1 的默认目录。需要 vfox 1.1.0 或更高版本。

title.en: Use an SDK that is already installed
